title: Public catalog row
description: One line of a release bundle's catalog/papers.jsonl: a public paper of the conference, linked to its official copy. Read by the public site (papers page, topic pages) and the cross-conference hub. Defined in v6.0-Public-Release Phase 4 (spec section 6.1); produced by the export in Phase 6.

official_url.description: The paper's official copy; null when none is known (the site then says so, never guesses).

topics.description: Topic ids that cite the paper.
